description: An objection to the application of a passed governance decision, raised inside the community's timelock window. Lives in the objector's own repo and is signed with the objector's key, so a contested application can be rechecked against signed records. This is tamper-evidence and public consistency rather than independence from the PDS, which holds the signing keys of the accounts it hosts; independence is complete only for externally-hosted objectors.

community.description: DID of the community the proposal belongs to.

proposal.description: Strong reference (uri + cid) to the proposal record as it stood when the objection was raised.

proposalRkey.description: Record key of the proposal record in the community repo.

decision.description: Strong reference to the net.openfederation.governance.decision record whose application is contested. An objection naming a different decision does not hold this application.

createdAt.description: When the objection was raised. An objection created at or after the proposal's applyAt is late and does not hold the application.
